opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 960.] Motion of respondent American Federation of Government Employees for divided argument granted, and the time is divided as follows: 20 minutes for the Federal Labor Relations Authority, and 10 minutes for the American Federation of Government Employees, AFL-CIO.
